hypotheses.hypothesis: The checkout service, along with downstream product-catalog and frontend services, experienced error rates due to failures in calls such as `oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder` and `oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct`
hypotheses.predicts: sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name="oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])) > 0 and on() sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="product-catalog", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name="oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])) > 0.05 and on() sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])) > 0.1
hypotheses.evidence: At 07:11:00Z all three parts hold: checkout's PlaceOrder SERVER spans failed at 0.0082/s, product-catalog's GetProduct SERVER spans at 0.149/s and the frontend's SERVER spans at 0.29/s. At the baseline 07:00:45Z none of the three error series exists, so the query returns nothing. The agent read this directly from its own query at 07:09:19Z (run 1, step 5), going one step beyond the page by naming product-catalog.

hypotheses.predicts: sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", span_name="oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])) > 0 and on() sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="product-catalog", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name="oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])) > 0.05
hypotheses.evidence: At 07:11:00Z checkout's CLIENT GetProduct calls failed at 0.0082/s while product-catalog itself answered GetProduct with errors at 0.149/s: the error originates in product-catalog and reaches checkout during order placement. Nothing is returned at the baseline 07:00:45Z, when neither error series exists.

hypotheses.hypothesis: **Product Catalog Service**: Failing with `oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct` returning `STATUS_CODE_ERROR` due to failures in downstream calls to `astronomy-db`.
hypotheses.predicts: sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="product-catalog", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name="oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])) > 0.05 unless on() histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="product-catalog", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", span_name="astronomy-db"}[5m]))) > 10
hypotheses.evidence: The component holds: product-catalog's GetProduct SERVER spans failed at 0.149/s at 07:11:00Z (nothing at the baseline). The mechanism does not: product-catalog's astronomy-db CLIENT spans have no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series at all, their p99 stayed at 1.98 ms (same as the baseline) and their rate barely moved (2.06/s -> 1.80/s), so the `unless` part is empty and the query returns 0.149. Right service, wrong mechanism.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The checkout errors are caused by upstream failures in the Product Catalog service when retrieving product details.
hypotheses.evidence: The prediction is that (almost) every failed order carries a failed product lookup. At 07:11:00Z checkout's failed GetProduct CLIENT calls (0.0082/s) equal its failed PlaceOrder SERVER spans (0.0082/s), so the comparison holds; at the baseline 07:00:45Z both series are absent and the query returns nothing. The agent calls product-catalog 'upstream' where it is a downstream dependency of checkout, but the causal claim - product detail retrieval failing breaks checkout - is what the data shows.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The underlying root cause of the Product Catalog service failure is database degradation or connectivity issues with the astronomy database (`astronomy-db`).
hypotheses.predicts: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="product-catalog", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", span_name="astronomy-db"}[5m]))) > 10 or sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="product-catalog", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", span_name="astronomy-db"}[5m])) < 0.5 * sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="product-catalog", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", span_name="astronomy-db"}[5m] offset 10m))
hypotheses.evidence: Degradation would show as slower database calls, connectivity issues as calls that drop away or fail. At 07:11:00Z the astronomy-db CLIENT spans of product-catalog had a p99 of 1.98 ms (identical to the baseline) and ran at 1.80/s against 2.06/s ten minutes earlier, far from halved; they have no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series at all. Both parts return nothing. The agent never queried astronomy-db: all its range queries used [1m] windows and came back empty, so the database claim was invented.
